title: SQL 存储过程与触发器 (Procedure & Trigger)
description: SQL 工作流系列 (16/16)：创建、调用、删除存储过程，以及 INSERT/UPDATE 触发器的基础写法

content.content: CREATE PROCEDURE get_user_orders(IN uid INT) BEGIN SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = uid; END;

content.tips: 带输出参数的存储过程
content.content: CREATE PROCEDURE count_orders(IN uid INT, OUT total INT) BEGIN SELECT COUNT(*) INTO total FROM orders WHERE user_id = uid; END;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_user_log AFTER INSERT ON users FOR EACH ROW INSERT INTO user_logs(user_id, action) VALUES (NEW.id, 'created');
CREATE TRIGGER trg_order_audit BEFORE UPDATE ON orders FOR EACH ROW INSERT INTO order_history(order_id, old_status, new_status) VALUES (OLD.id, OLD.status, NEW.status);
